title: delurio catalog (catalog/<locale>.json)
description: The words of a UI graph in one locale (SPEC.md §4): a JSON object from key to an ICU MessageFormat message. The file is named by its BCP 47 locale (en.json, tr.json, pt-BR.json). A captured catalog is copied from the app as it is, so its keys may be in any form.

additionalProperties.description: An ICU MessageFormat message. Today the tools fill simple arguments: `{param}` is filled from the node's `params`, which name sample or data values.
